title: Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL (PRM4RL), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL. For high-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask-oriented, fine-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress. For low-level reward generation, inspired by potential-based reward shaping

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的强化学习进展奖励模型
translated_abstract: 传统强化学习（RL）算法在处理具有稀疏奖励的长期任务时面临显著局限性。近期的进展利用大语言模型（LLM）的世界知识进行任务规划和奖励生成，从而增强强化学习。然而，基于规划的方法通常依赖预定义的技能库，无法优化低层控制策略；而基于奖励的方法由于任务的复杂性，需要大量的人类反馈或穷举搜索。在本文中，我们提出了面向强化学习的进展奖励模型（PRM4RL），这是一种将任务规划与密集奖励相结合以增强强化学习的新型框架。在高层规划方面，将复杂任务分解为一系列简单可管理的子任务，并设计了面向子任务的细粒度进展函数来监控任务执行进度。在低层奖励生成方面，受基于势函数的奖励塑形启发……
tldr: 提出PRM4RL框架，利用大语言模型将复杂任务分解为子任务并设计细粒度进展奖励函数，通过融合任务规划与密集奖励来增强强化学习在稀疏奖励长期任务上的能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes PRM4RL, a novel framework leveraging LLMs to decompose complex tasks into manageable subtasks with fine-grained progress reward functions, integrating task planning and dense rewards to enhance RL on long-horizon sparse-reward tasks.
